caption: The drawing depicts a single chalice or goblet positioned centrally within a square outline, using graphite or pencil on a beige or yellowed paper background. The goblet has a rounded, wide cup at the top, a narrow stem composed of three bulbous segments, and a broad, circular base. The shading on the goblet gives it a metallic appearance. Beneath the main drawing, there is a smaller schematic version of the goblet, annotated with numbers or measurements to the right side of this smaller sketch. The paper is discolored near the edges with areas of light stain, but the primary illustration is clear. The artist's signature, "MEYERS," appears in the lower left of the main square.
title: Pewter Chalice
